summary: Construct a MutationObserver retaining callback identity and microtask-delivery semantics.

target.notes: Create an observer storing the Web IDL callback; mutation delivery must integrate with the DOM mutation-observer microtask checkpoint.

semantics.callback_this: observer per Web IDL callback invocation rules

caveats: A normal Task/thread callback is not an equivalent scheduling primitive.
